📋 Workflow Architecture

Simple 4-Step Community Escalation

How SafeReach protects individuals through coordinated, multi-tier community dispatch.

01
🆘

Trigger Alert

Hold the SOS button for 3 seconds, speak a voice command, or shake your mobile device to initiate an instant alarm.

02
📍

GPS Broadcast

High-precision geolocation is captured and broadcast in real-time to family members and on-duty security.

03
⚡

Tier 1 Dispatch

Family and on-site guards receive push notifications and high-priority alarms to confirm dispatch within seconds.

04
🤝

Tier 2 Escalation

If unacknowledged within 3 minutes, the alarm automatically escalates to registered community volunteers and emergency services.

⭐ Capabilities

Built for Rapid Emergency Response

Enterprise-grade safety features engineered for reliability when every second matters.

📍

Live Geolocation Tracking

Continuous high-accuracy GPS coordinates update in real-time on interactive Leaflet maps with walking route estimates.

Multilingual Voice Commands
